source.name: card_fraud_simulated
source.why: card numbers, names, DOB, addresses, US ZIP codes: PCI/PII detection and US rule pack

prohibited_data: Column 'cc_num' appears to hold unmasked card numbers; PCI DSS v4.0 Req. 3.5.1 requires PAN to be unreadable wherever stored.
Column 'cc_num' appears to hold unmasked card numbers; PCI DSS v4.0 Req. 3.5.1 requires PAN to be unreadable wherever stored.

llm_rules.description: Credit card numbers must pass the Luhn checksum.
Credit card numbers must be 13 to 16 digits long.
ZIP codes must be five digits or five digits plus a hyphen and four digits.
State codes must be one of the 50 US state abbreviations.
Transaction timestamps must be valid dates and times.
Transaction timestamps cannot be in the future.
Date of birth must be a valid date.
Date of birth must not be older than 120 years.
Transaction amount must be greater than zero.
Fraud flag must be 0 (not fraud) or 1 (fraud).
Transaction number must be unique across the dataset.

source.name: bank_transactions
source.why: IDs, amounts, two timestamps, device/IP fields: timeliness and cross-date rules

llm_rules.description: Each transaction must have a unique identifier
Account identifiers must follow the pattern AA99999
Transaction amounts must be between 0.01 and 9999.99
Transaction timestamps cannot be in the future
Transaction type must be either Debit or Credit
Location names must contain only letters
Device identifiers must match pattern A999999
Merchant identifiers must match pattern A999
Channel must be Branch, ATM, or Online
Customer age must be between 0 and 120
Occupation must be one of the predefined categories
Duration must be between 0 and 999 seconds
Login attempts must be between 0 and 9
Account balance must be between -9999.99 and 99999.99
Previous transaction must be within the last 365 days

source.name: paysim
source.why: balances before/after each transfer: LLM-derived cross-column rules

llm_rules.description: Transaction step number must be a positive integer up to three digits
Transaction type must be one of the predefined payment operation codes
Transaction amount must be a positive monetary value up to two decimal places
Originator name must be present for every transaction
Originator old balance must be non‑negative and realistic
Originator new balance must be non‑negative and realistic
Destination name must be present for every transaction
Destination old balance must be non‑negative and realistic
Destination new balance must be non‑negative and realistic
Fraud flag must be 0 (not fraud) or 1 (fraud)
Flagged fraud indicator must be 0 or 1
